messages:
Nia P: Quick sync on postmortem action items for external comms — we need clear owners + deadlines for (1) short statuspage note, (2) customer-facing incident summary, (3) the policy + gating for full RCAs.
Carlos V: I can take the statuspage note and the short summary draft. ETA: tomorrow morning. will keep it 2-3 sentences for the page. :memo:
Rina T: Support will assemble the affected-customer list and impact tiering. ETA: today EOD. we'll mark SLA accounts separately.
Sasha B: Legal, are we ok publishing the sanitized summary publicly? and what triggers require an NDA or DSA before sharing detailed logs?
Legal Team: Public sanitized summaries are fine. Anything containing customer identifiers, raw logs, or internal credentials requires review + signed DSA. We recommend a redaction checklist and a standard "how to request more" template.
Carlos V: Thanks. I'll craft the summary with a "how to request more" paragraph linking to support and noting DSA requirement.
Nia P: Action list so far: Carlos -> statuspage + short summary draft by 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Rina -> impacted list + SLA flags by EOD today. Legal -> redaction checklist + template language by EOD tomorrow.
Ops Bot: Incident INC-2026-089 status changed to "postmortem_pending" by @nia at 2026-03-23T09:12:08Z.
Sasha B: Quick policy question: can AMs share a sanitized RCA directly with a customer, or should that go through Support?
Legal Team: AMs can share the sanitized public summary. For anything beyond that (appendix, logs), route through Support so we can track DSA requirements.
Rina T: For outreach cadence: SLA customers get an early tailored email once the summary is ready. All affected accounts get the sanitized summary via statuspage + support ticket within 48h.
Carlos V: Drafted short statuspage note and posted to #incidents-drafts. please review quickly, aiming to publish a 2-line note now and the longer summary after legal sign-off.
Nia P: Agree publish the short note ASAP for transparency; follow with the detailed sanitized summary within 48h after legal redaction. I'll add owners/timestamps to the incident action tracker and ping on the Wednesday follow-up.
Sasha B: Suggest we add a recurring action: after every Sev2/Sev1, product + legal run a 48h check to decide if the public summary needs updates (e.g., mitigation details).
Legal Team: Good idea. We'll add that to the checklist as a required follow-up.
Carlos V: One more thing — include a short "customer impact" bullet and a plain-language mitigation statement like "temporary routing fix deployed; permanent fix scheduled". avoid internal IDs.
Nia P: Great. I'll close the loop once statuspage is live and record completion in the action tracker. Thanks all. :handshake:
